subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should #87711 be narrowed first to the durable-before-binding reset/session invariant, or remain a broad Telegram reset/rehydration umbrella?
rationale: Source evidence supports the reset binding invariant, but the issue also asks for diagnostics and UX surfaces that require maintainer scoping before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to reset durability
options.body: Treat durable reset/session binding plus missing-transcript self-heal as the canonical fix, and split Telegram fallback, heartbeat, usage, and warm-reset UX into follow-ups.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as a tracking parent and require maintainers to designate separate canonical issues before repair work starts.

options.title: Prioritize visible Telegram recovery
options.body: Focus first on Telegram fallback or heartbeat behavior while leaving the lower-level phantom-binding invariant as separate work.

recommendation.title: Narrow to reset durability
recommendation.body: Treat durable reset/session binding plus missing-transcript self-heal as the canonical fix, and split Telegram fallback, heartbeat, usage, and warm-reset UX into follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest source-backed remaining failure mode is in reset transcript lifecycle history, where Tak Hoffman authored the central reset-path commits.
